title: Dispatch: 19.6.6 finding-registry ownership reconciliation (attempt 1)
description:
Implement eshyra-o9bd.19.6.6 (read it: description, NOTES, ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA). One file of data: docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/finding-registry.json (+ its validator/tests only if they pin these rows). Profile: rules-clause-complete (audit artifact truthfulness). No membership claim may be added (see the registry's explicitNonClaims). Do not change any other row.

SUPERVISOR DECISIONS (apply exactly; verify each factual claim yourself before writing it, and stop and report if a claim is false):
Vocabulary is fixed by packages/core/src/rules/findingRegistry.ts: status in accepted|rejected|narrowed|ambiguous|disclosed-dependency; non-accepted requires statusReasoning. Precedent for narrowing a pre-ADR invariant: KEEP the original `invariant` text verbatim (it records what the audit found) and narrow via status 'narrowed' + statusReasoning (see row rules-prose-readiness). Keep canonicalId, aliases, provenance, scopeKind unchanged on all five rows.

1. audit-readiness-gate (indep:001) 'Readiness gates require clause-complete procedures': status -> 'narrowed'; owningBead -> 'eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3'; statusReasoning states: ADR 0020 withdrew clause-complete closure as a gate requirement (cite ADR 0020 section 6 'No replacement global closure claim'); the surviving responsibility is re-freeze bar #4 (truthful in-band scope of every audit/readiness artifact, integrated transition design section 5.9): every automated gate states its bounded denominator and fails rather than false-greens unrecognized required input, which eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3 checks for the candidate bundle; previous owner eshyra-o9bd.19.1.5 closed as superseded without repairing this, so the finding stays open under the new owner.
2. readiness-integrity (opus:F-21) 'Readiness metadata reflects semantic completeness': status -> 'narrowed'; owner -> eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3; reasoning: under ADR 0020 readiness metadata is not required to reflect semantic completeness (no corpus-wide completeness claim exists); the surviving obligation is that readiness metadata claims no more than it measures (bar #4; 19.6.3 AC 'No bundle field claims universal clause/mechanic/deterministic/discovery completeness'). Previous owner closed as superseded.
3. readiness-artifacts (sol:CAP-014) 'Readiness artifacts agree with the corpus': still valid as stated under ADR 0020 -> keep status 'accepted'; owner -> eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3; add statusReasoning: re-owned from superseded eshyra-o9bd.19.1.5; agreement between candidate readiness artifacts and the candidate corpus is checked by eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3 (reproducible bundle identifying exact inputs). 
4. source-authority-opus-f19: keep status 'accepted' and owner eshyra-o9bd.19.2.1 (it closed WITH the repair). Rewrite statusReasoning to the actual disposition with evidence: PR #566 (eshyra-o9bd.19.2.1.2, merge 77b2d475) removed the composed spellPreparation quotation; VERIFY by reading `git show 77b2d475 --stat` and the current pack: each class record's data.spellPreparation.sourceText — check whether every one is a verbatim substring of source text (compare against the matching feature:<class>:spellcasting description or the importer's source extraction / source-region ledger; whitespace-normalize). State what you found: if all are verbatim, say the remaining sourceText values are verbatim source spans and no composed text is presented as quotation; if any is not verbatim, STOP and report (that would be a live source-authority defect, not a registry edit). Remove the 'until the clause IR follow-up lands' dependency (that follow-up, eshyra-r8r3/eshyra-pk7e, was retired 2026-09-22).
5. engine-capability-ownership (sol:CAP-007): keep status 'disclosed-dependency'; owner -> 'eshyra-o9bd.19.5.12'; reasoning: ownership of deterministic capabilities actually in force is the single authoritative inventory eshyra-o9bd.19.5.12; the per-family certification tasks and eshyra-olc5.2 were retired (2026-10-09 rebaseline) so nothing waits on family certification; the generated magic-item executionReadiness/engine:F1-F10 backlog is an unselected candidate backlog disclosed separately, and an unselected capability is not an ownership gap (ADR 0020 section 3). The dependency closes when 19.5.12 lands.
Wording: plain, factual, no hedging; do not claim the pack does or does not violate any row.

CHECKS: npm run verify:worktree (registry validation lives in packages/core/src/rules/findingRegistry.ts and packages/core/test/findingRegistry.test.ts; if a test pins an old owner/status of these rows, update it only to the new authoritative values and say so). Also grep the repo for other consumers of these canonicalIds (scripts/create-dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle etc.) and confirm nothing depends on the old owner.
REPORT (bd notes): before/after of each row, the F-19 verbatim verification result with method, commands run.
notes:
STOPPED before any registry edit: spec claim 4 (F-19) is FALSE. Method: extracted text of vendored packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf (pdftotext, whitespace/U+2011 normalized) and checked each sourceText in records.json spellPreparation (8 class records). Only class:bard sourceText is a verbatim span. class:cleric, class:druid, class:paladin, class:ranger, class:sorcerer, class:warlock, class:wizard each contain at least one sentence that is not a verbatim source span: e.g. source reads 'Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your druid spells, since your magic draws upon your devotion and attunement...' but sourceText ends the clause with a period; 'Charisma is your spellcasting ability for your warlock spells, so you use...' likewise. Composed text is built in packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/creationFacts.ts CLASS_SPELLCASTING, and field-provenance/fieldProvenanceDeclarations.ts already classes /spellPreparation/sourceText as source-derived ('not one verbatim quotation'). PR #566 (77b2d475) removed the composed spellPreparation quotation only partly: sourceText is still composed. Live source-authority defect for F-19 (out of scope for a registry edit). No registry rows changed; no commit. Rows 1,2,3,5 not written because the spec is halted at the F-19 check.
Verified before stop: audit-readiness-gate, readiness-integrity, readiness-artifacts, engine-capability-ownership current rows read (owners 19.1.5 / 19.5); test packages/core/test/findingRegistry.test.ts pins F-19 statusReasoning text and narrowed/statusReasoning counts, so it would need updating with the registry edit.
